---
title: "Voicenotes Android beta"
---

Sync notes from a fēnix 8 paired in Garmin Connect to an Android 11 or newer phone. The inbox accepts recordings up to 80,000 bytes. Larger notes stay available on the watch for playback and HTTPS upload.

## Install the beta

1. Install `bin/android/Voicenotes-beta.apk`. With USB debugging enabled, run `adb -d install -r bin/android/Voicenotes-beta.apk`.
2. Copy the signed watch build for your model to `GARMIN/APPS` over USB.

   | fēnix 8 variant | Device profile |
   | --- | --- |
   | 43 mm AMOLED | `fenix843mm` |
   | 47 mm or 51 mm AMOLED | `fenix847mm` |
   | 47 mm Solar | `fenix8solar47mm` |
   | 51 mm Solar | `fenix8solar51mm` |

3. Open Voicenotes on both devices. Select the fēnix 8 in the inbox if Garmin Connect lists several watches.
4. Use **Sync now** on either device or wait for the open inbox to check the watch. **On phone** confirms the phone saved the file.

To finish an active transfer while the phone is locked, enable **Allow sync to finish while locked** and grant the requested permissions. The inbox attempts the transfer for up to three minutes. Reopen it to resume a paused transfer.

Export any notes you want to keep before clearing or uninstalling the app. The watch remembers which notes it already sent.

## Build from source

1. Place the private companion source at `~/src/garmin-voicenotes-companion` or set `VOICENOTES_COMPANION_DIR`.
2. Set `ANDROID_HOME` to an SDK with platform 37 and use a Gradle-compatible JDK 17 or newer. Run `just android-beta` to build the APK.
3. Run `bash build.sh --companion --device <profile>` to build `bin/Voicenotes.prg` for your watch. The default and store builds exclude phone sync.

Reuse the Android signing key and Garmin developer key when installing updates.

## Preview in the Android emulator

Boot with `just android-emulator` in a separate terminal, then run `just android-preview beta`. Add the emulator serial if several are running. To transfer audio from a simulated watch, follow the [tethered demo](android-demo.qmd).

## Physical-device acceptance

- With the HTTPS receiver stopped, record and sync a note. Check its date, playback, Android sharing, and the watch’s **On phone** label.
- Interrupt Bluetooth mid-transfer. Reconnect and check that the transfer resumes and produces one copy. Repeat with the phone locked.
- Sync with the watch app closed. If delivery stalls, reopen it and check that the same note arrives.
- Record the watch model and firmware, Android version, and locked-phone result.

Run `just test-android-storage` for inbox storage checks. See the [simulator test guide](run-simulator-tests.qmd) for tethered tests.
